study type: Secondary data analysis of a demographic and health survey
cohort: 5310 reproductive age women in Gambia who gave birth in the five years preceding the 2019-20 Gambian demographic and health survey
finding: Late antenatal care initiation was prevalent (56%) among reproductive age women in Gambia and was associated with unplanned pregnancy, rural residence, lack of health insurance, previous cesarean delivery, and younger age.
